content.intro: In this lesson, you will study hashmap, linkedhashmap, and treemap with a short explanation, an original visual map, a Java example, and a check you can perform yourself. Focus on the relationship between the rule and the behavior rather than memorizing isolated syntax.
content.why_it_matters: This concept matters because it helps you select data structures according to ordering, uniqueness, lookup, and update needs. In this lesson, focus on hash-based lookup and use a minimal example to check what the rule actually guarantees.
